liz (devex): Hey team — opened PR with compact examples for function/tool calling + a short section on parsing patterns and JSON schema guardrails. would appreciate :eyes: on correctness and migration notes. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

sam (eng): Thanks — I'll skim. Is this the PR that switches the example shape from "tool" -> "tool_call"? that's a potential breaking note for older SDK examples.

liz (devex): Yes — we standardized on `tool_call` to match runtime payloads. The PR adds a migration tip but I want a short, clear line that says what code to change in client apps.

joel (ml): Quick note: examples should show both the structured-output JSON schema and how to parse fallback plain-text. Many customers hit edge cases when the model drops to free-form.

maria (docs): Agreed. I pushed a tiny commit suggestion in the PR: add a small code snippet for Python that demonstrates safe parsing.

maria (docs): Snippet I suggested (in PR comment):
```python
# safe parse pattern for function/tool calling response
resp = client.chat.complete(... )
if isinstance(resp.get('tool_call'), dict):
    args = resp['tool_call'].get('arguments', '{}')
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(args)
    except ValueError:
        # fallback: attempt heuristic extraction or raise a helpful error
        parsed = {}
else:
    # older payloads might include `tool` key
    args = resp.get('tool', {}).get('args')
```

sam (eng): Nice. Two small asks: 1) show the older->new key change (tool -> tool_call) as a one-line sed example so customers can grep/replace in codebases, 2) add a note about validating types from the schema before calling external tools.

liz (devex): Good call. I'll add a tiny migration bash snippet: `git grep -l "\"tool\"" | xargs sed -i "s/\"tool\"/\"tool_call\"/g"` and a short validation paragraph.

joel (ml): For the schema block, prefer this compact version (so it's easy to copy):
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "tool_call": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "name": {"type": "string"},
        "arguments": {"type": "string"}
      },
      "required": ["name", "arguments"]
    }
  }
}
```

maria (docs): Also add an explicit guardrail note: "If your tool expects structured arguments, prefer `arguments` as a JSON string and validate with `jsonschema` before invoking." Short sentence only.

liz (devex): Will do. One more: can someone confirm the SDK snippet for JS? I updated it but it's slightly different in behavior (auto-parsing vs raw).

sam (eng): I can post a tiny JS example in the PR thread in a bit. keep the default example explicit (i.e., show raw `arguments` string then `JSON.parse`). Avoid implying the SDK auto-parses.

alex (docs-bot): label added: `area:structured-output`, `needs-review` · preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/482 · staging-status: pending

maria (docs): tl;dr for PR description: "Adds compact examples for function/tool calling, migration tip for tool->tool_call, safe parsing patterns (python/js), and a JSON schema snippet for guardrails."

liz (devex): Perfect. I'll make the tiny edits (sed line + validation paragraph + JS example) today. If no objections, planning to merge after CI passes. :shipit:

sam (eng): tiny nit: in the JS snippet show `try { JSON.parse(args) } catch { /* fallback */ }` — newbies copy that a lot.

joel (ml): Add a line on regression testing: suggest adding a unit test that feeds a plain-text response and a structured response to ensure parser behavior doesn't regress.

liz (devex): Ok adding test suggestion. I'll ping again when the PR is updated. Thanks y'all. :raised_hands:

maria (docs): Also cross-link to the migration guide page under /docs/migration/api-shapes — few people search there first.

alex (docs-bot): linked PR to /docs/migration/api-shapes and added `audience:developers` tag

liz (devex): Updated PR with all the above (JS + sed + validation + tests + link). CI is running. If green, I'll merge in ~30m.

sam (eng): Thanks — will watch. :eyes:

alex (docs-bot): CI status: checks/presubmit: success · live-preview: queued

liz (devex): CI passed, merging now. Thanks for the quick reviews!

maria (docs): nice. can we add a very short note in the release notes (changelog) about the shape change? some customers subscribe to that only.

liz (devex): Good point — created a small PR against `changelog` repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/91 — added one-line note: "docs: standardize function tool payload to `tool_call` (see migration guide)"

sam (eng): :thumbsup:

joel (ml): Great, thanks all.

liz (devex): Closing thread. Feel free to reopen if someone spots something after merge. :)
